description: Agents use real GNOME/Wayland apps: on your screen, or an invisible second desktop you never see

cmd.description: Required at install time. PyGObject ships no PyPI wheels, so the environment must be able to see the distro package (python3-gi / python3-gobject / python-gobject). `deskwright-setup --check` prints the exact install line for the running distro.
cmd.name: --system-site-packages

name: io.github.tristanmuzzu/deskwright

environmentVariables.description: Which desktop to drive: 'primary' (the screen you are looking at), 'headless' for an invisible virtual-monitor session, or 'headless:<name>' to pick one of several.
environmentVariables.name: DESKWRIGHT_SESSION

environmentVariables.description: Force the input path: 'mutter' for GNOME's org.gnome.Mutter.RemoteDesktop (no consent dialog), 'portal' for org.freedesktop.portal.RemoteDesktop (one consent, then persisted). Auto-selected when unset.
environmentVariables.name: DESKWRIGHT_INPUT_BACKEND

runtimeArguments.description: Required at install time. PyGObject ships no PyPI wheels, so the environment must be able to see the distro package (python3-gi / python3-gobject / python-gobject). `deskwright-setup --check` prints the exact install line for the running distro.
runtimeArguments.name: --system-site-packages
